title: expansion
description: !SERVER DATAPACK! this pack allows you to make a server where you as the owner choose tasks the people have to complete. when the tasks are done, give the player a command block and it will expand the border! !SERVER DATAPACK!
body: EXPANSION! a datapack made for servers to make minecraft a tasks game! when you give a player a command block, the border expands! make sure to put this on a server where you have OP, else you cant give people command blocks. when the border expands, everyones inventory gets cleared
